brief_rationale: The doctor demonstrated complete responsibility chain coverage: recognizing the home execution failure, screening all red-flag symptoms, risk-stratifying appropriately, safely resolving the medication confusion by deferring to in-person verification, using workspace records, establishing a concrete follow-up plan, and providing privacy-friendly teach-back. Four high-order points were completed with meaningful impact: repairing the initial medication advice after the in-person visit clarified the conflict (HO1), providing executable action scripts for clinic contact (HO2), dynamically shifting priority when calls failed to recommend immediate in-person visit (HO3), and achieving safe bounded closure with clear resolved/unresolved items (HO4). All dimensions are excellent with no chain or non-chain defects.

closure_assessment.explanation: The episode achieved safe closure with all critical items resolved: red-flag screening complete, medication confusion clarified via in-person verification, follow-up appointment confirmed, and patient demonstrated correct understanding of all action items.
